capabilities: Encrypt and decrypt whole notes behind a locked view
Encrypt and decrypt selected text inline
Mark folders to auto-encrypt new and moved notes
Bulk encrypt or decrypt a folder recursively
Generate random passwords with configurable character classes
disambiguation: Not a whole-vault encryption tool; it encrypts individual notes, selections, and marked folders rather than the entire vault.
extras: README carries a prominent warning that forgotten passwords mean unrecoverable notes and that the crypto has not been independently audited; the manifest also flags that the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation via BRAT is recommended for testing.
intentEvidence: This plugin was forked from Meld Encrypt and renamed to Vault Encrypted.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plain Markdown files, so sensitive content is readable on disk and can leak through sync or backups.

relations.evidence: This plugin was forked from Meld Encrypt and renamed to Vault Encrypted.

summary: Encryption plugin that password-protects whole notes, selected text, or entire folders inside a vault using local AES-256-GCM cryptography.
